facts.fact: Kisan Vikas Patra pays 7.5% (compounded yearly) and the amount invested doubles in 115 months (9 years 7 months)
facts.quote: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) Rate of Interest: 7.5% (compounded yearly) Amount Invested doubles in 115 months (9 years & 7 months)
facts.note: India Post savings page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026'.

facts.fact: The NSI table shows KVP at 7.5% (115 months) up to 30.09.2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026)
Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The 30.09.2026 OM keeps all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so KVP stays at 7.5% (doubling in 115 months)
facts.note: Read by OCR from the scanned OM (DEA Budget Division, F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026); OCR prints '1st' as '1%' and '31st' as '31°'. The Q2 rate (KVP 7.5% (115 months)) is from the NSI table and India Post page; the Q3 value is derived from 'unchanged'.
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter

summary: KVP 7.5% / doubles in 115 months confirmed (India Post current page; NSI to 30.09.2026); DEA Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged' only in the scanned OM (manual). Audit 28 Oct 2026: the DEA OM of 30.09.2026 is now read by OCR and says Q3 rates remain unchanged from Q2.
